title: Describing Places
summary: Use there is/are for existence in a place; have/has for ownership. Add prepositions for precise location: on the wall, i
rule: Use there is/are for existence in a place; have/has for ownership. Add prepositions for precise location: on the wall, in the bag, at the door.
examples: There is a mirror on the wall.
She has keys in her bag.

commonMistakes.incorrect: The book is in the table.
commonMistakes.correct: The book is on the table.
commonMistakes.explanation: On for surfaces; in for enclosed spaces.

tutorHints: Draw a room plan for there is + prepositions.
